title: Mosaic: Efficient CPU-GPU Coordinated Block-Sparse Attention
abstract: arXiv:2605.07719v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Long-context LLM serving increasingly relies on CPU-resident context KV cache, driven by KV offloading and disaggregated prefill--decode execution. Although block-sparse attention reduces KV access, existing designs remain inefficient: GPU-centralized execution fetches selected KV blocks from CPU memory at each decoding step, making it PCIe-bound, while CPU--GPU partitioned execution places CPU-side sparse attention on the critical path, leaving substantial GPU time idle. This paper presents Mosaic, a CPU--GPU coordinated block-sparse attention system for efficient long-context decoding with CPU-resident context KV. Mosaic builds on three key insights: output-contribution-aware KV budgeting, head-specific and granularity-aware sparse configuration, and cross-device coordinated scheduling for sparse tasks over CPU-resident KV. Guided by these insights, Mosaic integrates a lightweight head-property predictor, a granularity--budge

translated_title: Mosaic：高效的CPU-GPU协同块稀疏注意力
translated_abstract: arXiv:2605.07719v2 公告类型：replace-cross 摘要：长上下文LLM服务日益依赖于驻留在CPU上的上下文KV缓存，这由KV卸载和分离式预填充-解码执行所推动。尽管块稀疏注意力减少了KV访问量，但现有设计仍然效率低下：GPU集中式执行在每个解码步骤中都需要从CPU内存获取选定的KV块，使其受限于PCIe带宽；而CPU-GPU分区式执行则将CPU侧的稀疏注意力置于关键路径上，导致大量GPU时间闲置。本文提出了Mosaic，一个用于在CPU驻留上下文KV下实现高效长上下文解码的CPU-GPU协同块稀疏注意力系统。Mosaic建立在三个关键洞察之上：输出贡献感知的KV预算分配、针对注意力头且粒度感知的稀疏配置，以及针对CPU驻留KV的跨设备协同调度。基于这些洞察，Mosaic集成了一个轻量级的注意力头属性预测器和一个粒度-预算（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: Mosaic提出了一种CPU-GPU协同的块稀疏注意力系统，通过输出贡献感知的KV预算分配、注意力头特定且粒度感知的稀疏配置以及跨设备协同调度，解决了长上下文LLM解码中CPU驻留KV缓存访问受PCIe带宽限制和GPU闲置的低效问题。
en_tdlr: Mosaic is a CPU-GPU coordinated block-sparse attention system that enables efficient long-context decoding with CPU-resident KV cache through output-contribution-aware KV budgeting, head-specific granularity-aware sparse configuration, and cross-device coordinated scheduling, overcoming PCIe-bound data transfer and GPU idle time in existing designs.
